community_identity: community_id is local to one state and side and is not a persistent semantic identity
cross_side_evidence: See cross_side_edges.csv.gz for cross-region directed relations retained from R005 combined 10-nearest-neighbour graphs.
interpretation_boundary: Layer-wise differences arise from changing R004 membership inside one fixed static embedding topology. Positive means target-relative alignment and negative means anti-alignment. Neither establishes a topic, suppression, contradiction, exclusion or curvature.
